objective: Maximize reproducible reciprocal pooled OOF; per-movie stability and LB are diagnostics, not local-research vetoes.
honesty_note: EXP185 caused this mechanism family to be retained, so EXP186 is not untouched confirmatory OOF. Within the frozen seven-variant grid, each movie is excluded from the parameter-selection score used for that movie.
diagnostics: edge TP/FP/FN and adjusted edge Jaccard
node recall and predicted node count

protocol.selection: For each held-out movie, select the highest pooled score variant on the other 11 movies of the same direction, then aggregate only the 24 selected held-out rows.
protocol.baseline_reproduction: g50_t25 must reproduce every EXP185 per-movie metric within 1e-12 before selection runs

efficiency.heatmap_policy: Infer each model/movie/frame heatmap once, then reuse atomic .npy cache for all remaining frozen variants.
efficiency.cleanup: After verified export, delete reproducible heatmap cache, pyc, empty logs and duplicate selector logs; retain unique metrics, config and launch evidence.

observations: One participant reports about 0.96 CV versus 0.93 LB.
Another reports an edge-weight model gaining about 0.02-0.04 on each of five folds with about zero LB gain.
Participants recommend decomposing score into edge, adjusted edge, node, count, division and trajectory diagnostics.

yusuketogashi_clean_local_cv.finding: Useful short-track-rescue mechanism, but the fixed-8 absolute score is not accepted as honest reciprocal OOF because the attached public support weights may already have seen those training movies.

evgendvorkin_proxy_09417.finding: The 0.9417 proxy is a small selected validation proxy, not comparable to our 24-movie embryo-disjoint OOF. Mechanisms retained for later isolated tests include cached post-processing sweep, short-track rescue and wider division geometry.

promotion_rule: Record any positive nested pooled gain as useful local evidence. Do not require nonnegative per-movie deltas. Kaggle submission remains separately gated by AGENTS.md.
